title: OlmoEarth turns satellite foundation models into continent-scale maps
friendlyTitle: OlmoEarth helps turn satellite data into large AI maps
summary: Ai2 has detailed the OlmoEarth Platform, which handles satellite-data preparation, model adaptation and large-scale geospatial inference for uses such as wildfire risk, food security and deforestation monitoring. A recent North America run used distributed CPU and GPU stages to reduce thousands of serial compute hours to roughly 30.5 hours.
friendlySummary: Ai2 built a platform that prepares satellite images, runs Earth-observation AI and joins the results into maps across very large areas.
whyItMatters: Open Earth-observation models are difficult to use without pipelines for imagery, projections, failures and map assembly. Packaging that infrastructure can give environmental and public-interest teams access to useful regional analysis without requiring them to become cloud-computing specialists.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Teams can study wildfire risk, forests or food security without building every part of a huge data system themselves.
